subject: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use
messages:
From: Caroline Peters <caroline.peters@quantifai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Monroe <alex@quantifai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the great demo last week. Quantifai would like to move forward with a short joint case study and a coordinated press announcement tied to our deployment next month. A couple of asks from our comms team:

- We need a 30-day embargo from the day the case study is signed.
- Logo use: Quantifai is comfortable with Redwood using our logo on the case study and on social posts, but we require a brand-approved asset set and guidelines — we can provide those.
- Reference quote: we can provide a customer quote but Quantifai legal requires pre-approval of the exact quote and attribution.

I've attached our asset request doc (Quantifai_Asset_Request.docx). Can you loop in legal so we can get the publicity clause and any MSA/order-form redlines squared away quickly? We aim to publish the week of Aug 20.

Appreciate it —
Caroline
Head of Comms, Quantifai

Attachment: Quantifai_Asset_Request.docx (docx, 84 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Peters <caroline.peters@quantifai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use

Caroline — thanks for the clarity and the asset doc. Looping in Laura from Legal and Rafael from CS to align on approvals and the MSA/order form language.

Laura / Rafael — Quantifai wants a 30-day embargo and pre-approval of any quote / attribution. They also expect us to get logo usage approved against their brand pack. Quantifai is otherwise happy to proceed and hopes to publish week of Aug 20.

Can Legal confirm if a 30-day embargo is acceptable and whether the standard publicity clause in our MSA needs amendment to capture pre-approval and restricted asset use? If we need an order-form attachment or a short addendum, please advise on timeline — Quantifai would like to sign before Aug 1.

Thanks —
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Quoted text removed]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Caroline Peters <caroline.peters@quantifai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use

Karthik / Rafael —

Thanks for the heads up, Caroline. I reviewed the standard publicity language and recommend the following changes to satisfy Quantifai's asks while protecting Redwood:

1) Embargo: Agree to a 30-day embargo, provided we include a mutual sign-off process. Proposal: Quantifai provides the draft case study and proposed social posts; Redwood will review and provide approval or comments within 7 business days.

2) Logo & asset use: Accept logo usage limited to the case study, marketing webpages, and social channels. We should require use of Quantifai-approved assets and prohibit alterations that change aspect ratio or colors. Add a clause that we will remove or stop use within 30 days of written request.

3) Quote & attribution: Replace unilateral attribution language with explicit pre-approval for any direct customer quote (Quantifai must approve final quote in writing). For anonymous or paraphrased statements, we will not attribute to Quantifai without approval.

4) Order form / addendum: Because Quantifai is requesting specific publicity terms, I recommend a 1-page addendum to the Order Form capturing embargo mechanics, approval windows, and permitted asset types. I'll draft redlines and return them by EOD.

I'll attach a redlined MSA excerpt and a short addendum template in my next email. If this is time-sensitive for marketing, Rafael please flag any CS constraints.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlined_MSA-2028-07-20.pdf (pdf, 46 KB)

From: Alex Monroe <alex@quantifai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use

Laura — thanks for the quick review. The 7 business day approval window is acceptable to us, and we can provide the brand assets. One request: can the embargo be counted from the date of final signature, rather than from draft delivery?

If that works we can sign the addendum this week. We prefer to keep attribution language tight — we'll only approve exact quotes we are comfortable with.

Karthik — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Alex
Operations, Quantifai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Caroline Peters <caroline.peters@quantifai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantifai case study: press embargo & logo use

All —

Per Alex, we'll set the embargo to run from the date of final signature; Quantifai provides assets, Redwood gets 7 business days to review drafts and proposed copy. I've prepared a very short addendum that: (a) records the 30-day embargo, (b) commits both parties to the 7-business-day approval timeline, (c) narrows permitted logo usage, and (d) requires written approval for any direct quote attribution.

I'm tagging Marissa since this is a slightly non-standard publicity ask tied to a co-marketing timeline — Marissa, can you sign off on the addendum and the go-to-market timing so I can send the final to Quantifai for signature? If you approve, I'll route the 1-page addendum for e-signature today (DocuSign link attached).

Thanks —
Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
